ei.title: I remember the day my first book came out.

fullPassage: I remember the day my first book came out. The week before, I talked to people around me almost every day about how excited I was, how long I had waited, and how it felt just like being a little kid waiting for Christmas Eve. Finally, the big day arrived and I woke up happy, already embarrassed by all the praise and attention I thought would come. I made coffee and waited for someone to call and congratulate me. But the phone didn't know its part. It sat there silent as death with a head cold. By noon, the silence was getting on my nerves. I sat by the phone like a loyal dog. Finally, it rang at four. I picked it up — only to hear someone asking for someone else. I kept glancing at the phone for hours, but it never rang again. The day ended in silence, and so did my excitement.

questions.stem: 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중에서 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ④ have → had. 주절이 과거이고 대과거(더 앞선 과거)를 나타내므로 과거완료 had waited가 와야 합니다.
det.analysis:
✅ ① came: come의 과거형 → 적절
✅ ② talked: 과거형 → 적절
✅ ③ was: 과거형 → 적절
❌ ④ have → had: 과거 시제(talked) 기준 그 전부터 지금까지 기다려온 것이므로 대과거(had waited) 필요.
det.tip: 대과거 had + p.p. = 과거보다 더 앞선 과거

det.korean: ② embarrassing → embarrassed. 주어(I)가 쑥스러움을 '느끼는' 수동이므로 과거분사 embarrassed가 와야 합니다.

❌ ② embarrassing → embarrassed: 사람이 감정을 '느끼면' 과거분사. I felt embarrassed ✓
✅ ③ to call: wait for + O + to부정사 → 적절
✅ ④ congratulate: to call and congratulate 병렬 → 적절
det.tip: 감정분사: embarrassed(사람)/embarrassing(일·상황)

det.korean: ④ hear → to hear. 'only to + 동사원형'은 '~했으나 결국 ~하게 되다'의 결과 부정사 용법.
det.analysis:
✅ ① didn't: 과거 부정 → 적절
✅ ② sat: sit의 과거형 → 적절
✅ ③ getting: 과거진행형 was getting → 적절
❌ ④ hear → to hear: only to V(부정사 부사적 용법, 결과). '전화를 받았으나 결국 다른 사람 찾는 소리를 듣게 되다'.
det.tip: only to + V = ~했으나 결국 ~하게 되다 (예상 밖 결과)

det.korean: ② blame(비난) → praise(칭찬). 축하 전화를 기대하는 맥락이므로 blame은 부적절.

det.tip: praise(칭찬) ↔ blame(비난). praise and attention = 칭찬과 관심
